AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Visually searches for text through the device camera: the user points the camera at the world and matching text is highlighted live in the viewfinder. Operational Patterns: - Use 'startQuickSearch' when the user wants to find a piece of text in their physical surroundings (e.g. a gate number, a name on a list, a word on a shelf). - The function returns an intent that opens the camera screen with the search active; the user then points the camera at what they want to scan. Constraints: - 'query' cannot be empty or blank. - Searching only works while the app is open with the camera running; there is no background or headless search.
